notes:
Dayforce HCM board — first of this platform in the corpus. The Costa Rica scope is carried by the URL PATH (/es-MX/medplast/COSTARICA), not a query filter, so there is nothing to pre-apply and expected_unfiltered_count=10 equals expected_jobs. Tenant slug is 'medplast' (Viant Medical's former name), hence the alias.

Prefix derives cleanly to /es-MX/medplast/COSTARICA/jobs with no LinkRule override — unusual for this corpus and worth keeping that way.

Two things checked rather than assumed. (1) 'Leer más' is NOT a load-more: there are exactly 10 of them, one per posting, and clicking one navigates into the job detail page (/jobs/27120). The probe reports no pagination affordance, and hard scrolling adds nothing, so 10 is the complete set. (2) The board does expose location controls the agent could disturb — an ARIA combobox 'locationString' and a 'distance' input — even though the scope is already in the path; hooks.filter_already_applied=True guards against the agent driving them, and the live run settles in 4 steps.

Anchors render twice per posting (20 raw, 10 unique); the matcher's href dedup collapses them. The queue's original sample_job_url (/jobs/30358) had closed by integration time; a live posting is shipped instead.
